SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.student_id, p.mission_id, v.title AS mission_title, p.status, a.input_type, a.plain_text, a.content::text AS content_json, p.created_at FROM community_post p JOIN answer a ON a.id = p.answer_id JOIN attempt t ON t.id = p.attempt_id JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = t.mission_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM community_post WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post (id, student_id, mission_id, attempt_id, answer_id, status, created_at, status_changed_at, error_report_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{missionId}, #{attemptId}, #{answerId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{statusChangedAt}, #{errorReportId,jdbcType=OTHER}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET status = #{status}, status_changed_at = #{now}, error_report_id = COALESCE(#{errorReportId,jdbcType=OTHER}::uuid, error_report_id) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET status = #{to}, status_changed_at = #{now} WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = #{from}
